description: Search property FOR SALE on The NLS, the MLS for Spain (Costa del Sol, Costa Blanca, Mallorca). Pass the buyer's brief as `query` in plain English or Spanish, e.g. "3 bed villa with sea views in Marbella under 2m" or "ático con piscina en Estepona hasta 600.000"; it is turned into filters and the filters used are returned in `interpreted`. You may also set the structured fields directly; they override anything read from `query`. Always give the user each property's `url` (its page on thenls.com) and, when useful, `browse_url` for more results. Sales only; no rentals. Never returns private listings, contacts, owner data, notes, street addresses or coordinates.

area.description: Town or district, e.g. Marbella, Estepona, Benahavís, Nueva Andalucía, Puerto Banús, Altea, Palma.

features.description: Must-have features, e.g. "sea views", "private pool", "close to golf", "close to sea", "gated community", "garden", "lift".

language.description: Answer language. "es" = Spanish titles, descriptions, features and thenls.com/es/ links. Defaults to Spanish when the brief is in Spanish (and always on /es/mcp).

query.description: Plain-language brief or keywords (English or Spanish), e.g. "3 bed villa with sea views in Marbella under 2m".

type.description: apartment, villa, penthouse, townhouse, house, plot, duplex or finca.

name: search_properties

interpreted.description: Filters read from the plain-language query.

description.description: Start of the listing description (Spanish when language is es and an up-to-date translation exists).

listing_agent.description: Public profile of the agent authorised to sell the property.

title: Search public properties
